'''Flensia''' was a female [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she resided on [[Voss]], providing training to [[Sith Warrior]]s.
